title: Private Tour: Vancouver Craft Beer Tasting Tour
includes: All taxes, fees, and handling charges
requirements: All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Must be 19 years of age and have two types of government-issued ID, if requested
policies: After arriving in Vancouver, please call to check in
cancellation: All sales are final. No refund is available for cancellations.
blurb: Discover Vancouver’s burgeoning microbrew industry on this private, 3-hour, craft beer tasting tour. British Columbia is going through a renaissance in craft beer production, as new micro breweries are popping up all over, especially in Vancouver. This craft beer tasting tour will give all beer lovers the chance to try many different varieties at four of the city's finest microbreweries. All tasting fees plus transportation are included.
